page_title: SAL 1-1 UDI | Salernitana v Udinese 28/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Davide Massa is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90+5' It's time for a substitution. Domingos Quina (Udinese) comes on in place of Florian Thauvin.
90+4' The referee shows a yellow card to Walace (Udinese). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+4' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+3' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
90+2' A pass from Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) is intercepted by Marco Silvestri and the move breaks down.
90+1' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

90' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The ball is out of play. Salernitana win a corner kick.
90' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
88' Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Davide Massa stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

86' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
86' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

86' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the right side of the goal, but Marco Silvestri pulls off a great save to deny him. Salernitana get a corner.
85' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner but it's cleared.
84' Paulo Sousa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) replacing Grigoris Kastanos.
84' The substitution is prepared. Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lorenzo Pirola.

83' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Salernitana have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
82' The game is interrupted. Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
82' Andrea Sottil has decided to substitute Sandi Lovric and he is replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hassane Kamara departs the field of play to be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
81' Salernitana failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

80' Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) drives a shot towards the top right corner from inside the box, but Marco Silvestri leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. Good work from Salernitana as they win a corner.
79' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
78' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Salernitana win a corner.
78' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
77' A cross into the box from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is cleared. The ball is out of play and Salernitana manage to earn a corner.
77' The foul by Isaac Success (Udinese) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
75' Andrea Sottil has decided to make a change. Festy Ebosele (Udinese) replaces Joao Ferreira.
75' It is time for a substitution. Isaac Success (Udinese) is on for Lorenzo Lucca.
74' 5:14 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
73' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
72' 1 - 1 Goal! Antonio Candreva plays a pass to the feet of Boulaye Dia (Salernitana), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:1.
72' Paulo Sousa has decided to substitute Grigoris Kastanos and he is replaced by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana).
72' Paulo Sousa prepares a substitution. Lorenzo Pirola is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
71' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The ball is behind the touchline and Salernitana will take a throw-in.
70' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

70' A pass travels right across the box to Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Marco Silvestri denies him with a decent save.
67' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Joao Ferreira (Udinese) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
67' Udinese take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

66' A sweet pass finds Sandi Lovric (Udinese) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Guillermo Ochoa is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Udinese earn a corner.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch for Pasquale Mazzocchi.
62' Here is a change. Erik Botheim is going off and Paulo Sousa gives the last tactical orders to Jovane Cabral (Salernitana).
60' Erik Botheim (Salernitana) picked up a yellow card from referee.
57' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Lorenzo Lucca provided an assist for the goal.
55' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
53' Paulo Sousa decides to make a substitution. Emil Bohinen will be replaced by Agustin Martegani (Salernitana).
52' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
52' Matteo Lovato (Salernitana) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
51' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) tries to find Boulaye Dia, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
49' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
49' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
48' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
45+2' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45+1' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Udinese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.

44' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Guillermo Ochoa, who pulls off a stunning save!
44' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
44' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
43' Davide Massa blows the whistle, Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is penalised for a foul.
41' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
40' A quickly taken corner by Salernitana.
40' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Silvestri intercepts the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Salernitana are going to take it.
39' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.

38' Emil Bohinen (Salernitana) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
37' Salernitana are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
36' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

35' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Antonio Candreva was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.

34' A rebound falls at the feet of Nehuen Perez (Udinese) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
34' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.

33' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
30' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends a chip pass into the box, but Guillermo Ochoa is quickest to intercept the ball.
30' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
29' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.
28' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
27' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sees his long-range effort blocked.

25' A cross by Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
24' The referee blows his whistle as Christian Kabasele (Udinese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
23' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) and Erik Botheim attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
21' Referee Davide Massa sees the trip by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

18' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
17' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
16' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
16' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.

14' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Udinese win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
14' A cross from Joao Ferreira (Udinese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
13' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Udinese will take a throw-in.
13' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Christian Kabasele (Udinese) and blew his whistle.

10' The ball is played back to Walace (Udinese), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
9' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.
8' Davide Massa blows for a foul after Hassane Kamara (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Salernitana get a free kick.
6' Walace (Udinese) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range attempt straight to the middle of the goal.
4' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Udinese are taking a throw-in.
3' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
3' Guillermo Ochoa makes a save to deny the long-range effort from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) towards the middle of the goal.

Salernitana will kick the game off.
Davide Massa will supervise the game today.
